name: KATE x KASEY
website_meta_description: KATE x KASEY is a boutique print studio specializing in exclusive prints for home and fashion clients worldwide.

pages.text: KATE x KASEY 0 Skip to Content SHOP PRINTS CLIENT WORK CONTACT OUR STORY Open Menu Close Menu Open Menu Close Menu SHOP PRINTS CLIENT WORK CONTACT OUR STORY SHOP PRINTS CLIENT WORK CONTACT OUR STORY Welcome to Our Colorful World! We create extraordinary prints for fashion, home and beyond. As a boutique studio everything is created by founding artists Kate Aurelia and Kasey Free. Seeking Fresh Prints? Find the perfect prints for your next collection! Our shop is filled with hundreds of beautifully crafted prints, available for exclusive purchase and immediate download. All files are in seamless repeat and production-ready. Register below to shop them all. SHOP PRINTS Custom Designs We are passionate about working alongside our clients to bring their visions to life. Our custom art is created exclusively for you, tailored to meet your design brief and requirements. With our vast industry knowledge and expertise, we seamlessly combine our signature style with your brand’s aesthetic. CONTACT US Client Shortlist @katexkasey instagram hello@katexkasey.com ©2025 KATE x KASEY. All rights reserved.
